21:
Baba?

Before anything else, I need to say this properly.

I’m really sorry for how I acted earlier :( I know I came off rude and mean, and you didn’t deserve that from me. I let my emotions speak before my understanding did, and I regret that.

When I woke up and saw your message saying you were going out, I was already feeling upset and vulnerable. Instead of asking calmly or telling you how I felt, I assumed things and let that frustration build up inside me. I didn’t say good morning, I didn’t tell you I was awake the whole time, and when we talked, I let that bottled-up feeling come out in my tone. That’s on me.

When I fired back about you not saying anything after “I’m going out,” I wasn’t trying to communicate — I was reacting. I spoke from hurt instead of care, and I understand why that escalated things. I can see now how it made you feel like I was blaming you, when I should’ve just been honest about what was going on in my head.

I want you to know that I wasn’t trying to pick a fight or make you feel bad. I was upset, yes, but that doesn’t excuse being sharp or dismissive with you. You deserve patience, gentleness, and clarity from me — especially when things are already sensitive.

I’m sorry for not saying good morning. I’m sorry for not telling you I was awake. And I’m sorry for letting my tone hurt you when we finally talked. I should’ve handled that moment with more care, because you matter to me.

I’m still learning how to communicate better when my emotions are loud, but please know that my heart was never against you. I care about you deeply, and I hate knowing that my words or tone made you feel otherwise.

Thank you for still talking to me, for listening, and for trying to understand me even when things got messy. I promise to do better — to speak softer, to ask instead of assume, and to remember that we’re on the same side. 

And also I want to speak gently to your heart, because I know it’s been heavy. I know there are moments when you look at us and wonder if you’re enough, or if you’re failing me in some way. I need you to hear this clearly, without doubt or hesitation:

You are not failing me. Not even close baby okay? 

I don’t love you for what you can give me, or for how much effort you manage to show, or for how perfectly you express your love. I don’t love you for consistency, productivity, reassurance, or sacrifice. I love you for who you are — the person you are when you laugh, when you’re quiet, when you’re unsure, when you’re tired, when you’re simply being yourself. That version of you is the one I chose, and the one I continue to choose every day.

If there are times when it feels like I’m giving more, please don’t see that as a burden you need to carry. I’m not keeping score. I’m not waiting for you to repay me or catch up. I give because loving you comes naturally to me. It’s not a chore, and it’s not something I do out of obligation. I do it because my heart wants to, because you matter to me, because choosing you feels right.

I know you worry that you can’t give me what I deserve. But love isn’t about deserving or earning — it’s about choosing, staying, and growing together. We love differently, and that doesn’t mean one love is stronger or weaker than the other. It just means we are two different people learning how to meet each other where we are.

I don’t want perfection from you. I don’t want you to stretch yourself thin trying to be something you think I need. I want you — honest, imperfect, real. I want the quiet moments, the misunderstandings we learn from, the days when things feel easy and the days when they don’t. All of it belongs to us.

Everything is okay my baby. We are okay. Even when things feel messy or unclear, even when emotions run high, I’m still here. I’m not holding your love against you, and I’m not measuring your worth by what you can give me. My heart is calm with you, even when the world feels loud.

So please don’t carry the fear that you’re not enough. You don’t need to be more, or do more, or try harder just to be loved by me. You already are enough — exactly as you are, exactly where you are.

I’m here because I want to be. I stay because I choose you. Always.

Regardless,
King

January wasn’t easy. 
It came with misunderstandings, 
difficult conversations, 
and moments where distance felt heavier than usual. 
There were days we didn’t fully understand each other, 
days where emotions got tangled, 
days where loving each other took effort instead of ease. 

And yet — we stayed. 

I’m so proud of us. 
Proud that we chose to talk instead of walk away, 
to fight for each other instead of against each other. 
Proud that even with the distance, 
we kept showing up, 
kept choosing patience, 
reassurance, 
and love. 
None of it was perfect, 
but it was real, 
and it was ours. 

Looking back at January, 
I don’t just see the hard parts. 
I see growth. 
I see two people learning how to love each other better, 
how to hold on even when it would’ve been easier to let go. 
We proved to ourselves that what we have is stronger than misunderstandings and bigger than the miles between us. 

As we step into February, I carry all of that with me — 
gratitude, 
pride, 
and a deeper kind of love. 
Thank you for staying. 
Thank you for choosing us. 
No matter what comes next, 
I’m proud to be doing this with you. 
I love you bal!
